useCase: Localizing manipulated regions and creating 操作 probability heatmaps
mechanism: Divides the image into overlapping patches and classifies each independently using a lightweight CNN. Creates a spatial probability map showing 操作 likelihood per region. Aggregates patch-level predictions for an overall assessment. Effective at localizing manipulated regions 内の an image.
accuracy: 中-高 - 80-88% for detecting local 操作s
name: パッチベースフォレンジクス (CNN)
source: Chai et al. (2020) - What Makes Fake Images Detectable? Understanding Properties that Generalize, ECCV
parameters: Patch size: 128x128, Stride: 64, CNN: custom lightweight (4 conv layers), Aggregation: mean + max pooling of patch scores
description: 使用します CNN classifiers on small image patches を検出するために local 操作s. Each patch is independently classified, creating a 操作 probability map.

references.title: Chai, L. et al. (2020). What Makes Fake Images Detectable? Understanding Properties that Generalize. ECCV.
Wang, S.Y. et al. (2020). CNN-Generated Images Are Surprisingly Easy to Spot...For Now. CVPR.

strengths:
• Provides spatial localization of 操作s
• Lightweight and fast inference
• Generalizes にわたる different 操作 types
• Can detect partial 画像操作s
limitations:
• Small patch size may miss global 不整合
• Boundary effects 間の patches
• Performance depends on training data diversity
• May struggle with full-image generation (no local boundaries)
